title: One Saga, observed or compared
statement: A Saga is opened to observe the app at one commit, or to compare what a branch changes from its merge-base the way a pull request does; the comparison is how the Saga is opened, never stored.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Compare starts from the merge-base of the given commit and HEAD, the way a pull request does.
The Changed layer lists Saga records added, revised, or retired, each with its before and after.

The Affected layer lists records the change did not edit but invalidated: anything pinned to a revision that changed, and any node whose referenced code changed, so a code-only change still lights up the stories, designs, and personas it touches.
The Code layer groups diff hunks under the nodes that reference them, plus every changed line no node references.
status and query accept the same --against as open, so an agent's work queue is scoped to one change.
